user.title: Assist Canonicalizer
user.description: Configure the Assist Canonicalizer integration to preprocess and canonicalize Assist requests.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Assist Canonicalizer is allowed.

init.title: Assist Canonicalizer Options
init.description: Configure settings and behavior for Assist Canonicalizer.

set_fallback_agent.name: Set fallback agent
set_fallback_agent.description: Change the fallback conversation agent used for future requests.

agent_id.name: Conversation agent
agent_id.description: The conversation agent to use when Assist Canonicalizer falls back.

test_match.name: Test match
test_match.description: Return ranked candidates for a text input using lexical scoring and custom thresholds.

text.name: Text
text.description: The input text to canonicalize and match.

language.name: Language
language.description: The language of the input text. If omitted, falls back to the Home Assistant configuration language.

rebuild_index.name: Rebuild index
rebuild_index.description: Rebuild the search index for a language from automatic candidate sources.

language.name: Language
language.description: The language of the index to rebuild. If omitted, falls back to the Home Assistant configuration language.

clear_index.name: Clear index
clear_index.description: Clear a language index or all indexes.

language.name: Language
language.description: The language of the index to clear. If omitted, all language indexes are cleared.

diagnostics.name: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Return runtime diagnostics for Assist Canonicalizer.

dump_candidates.name: Dump candidates
dump_candidates.description: Return candidate pool details for a specific language.

language.name: Language
language.description: The language of the candidate pool to dump. If omitted, falls back to the Home Assistant configuration language.

rebuild.name: Rebuild
rebuild.description: Force an index rebuild before dumping.
